name: Phase 0 extracted properties for Li6PS5Cl
purpose: Phase 0 extraction fixture for the battery MVP known-borderline control (PRD §Scope Li6PS5Cl). Captures argyrodite RT conductivity, activation energy, and oxidative-stability concerns.
notes: DOIs are real and resolvable. Page numbers / tables / figure references are plausible primary-source guesses; verified=false until live licence-checking and citation verification by lead agent.
